topic: The HR manager who finally stopped processing leave requests on WhatsApp — what changed in week one
format: Before/after of a single workflow: same task, two completely different experiences
post:
Monday morning: 14 unread WhatsApp messages. Three leave requests buried in a thread about weekend shifts. One already missed.

Friday of the same week — after switching to SmartPRO Hub: every request logged, approved, and recorded before 9am.

That's not an exaggeration. That's what one HR manager at a trading company in Muscat reported after her first week on the platform.

Week one after onboarding: 100% of requests processed through a single workflow. Response time dropped from hours to minutes. No lost threads. No "I thought you approved it."
